I dabble in both windows and Linux and was wondering how Ark performs on Linux? More specifically the Ubuntu distro.
How are people finding the Linux version of Ark?
I haven't had any issues with it on Kubuntu, but in all honestly, I'm just a user.

I'm using Debian, so it's probably very similar what you're gonna have on Ubuntu.

Most people says it runs horribly, but honestly it's completly playable, i've been pleasantly surprised.

I have a 3+ years old rig (GTX 570, i5 2500k, 8GB RAM, Debian 8) and it's very smooth. Granted I play on medium and I have 'only' around 30 fps most of the time, but it doesn't bother me.

The first day had much much worse perfs and a few bugs. There's still only 2 real bug in the linux version,

  • Character preview is not displayed properly (in the inventory or at the creation of your character), but frankly, I don't give a damn.
  • Multi Monitor is very wonky (at least with gnome3), you HAVE to play in Windowed fullscreen, but that's what I always choose so... I don't care either.

Overall, i'm very please with the Linux verson atm.
